notTaken.why: a booting device always carries its boot op, and reconcile leaves a device with an op in flight to the op's outcome or deadline
only an op's outcome or deadline fails a device, and every op moves a ready device out of ready first
only an op's outcome or deadline fails a device, and every op moves a leased device out of leased first
a resetting device carries its reset op; reconcile leaves it to the op's outcome or deadline
a releasing device carries its release op (or moves on to shutDown in the same step)
a shutting-down device carries its shutdown op; reconcile leaves it to the op's outcome or deadline
a failed device recovers to shutdown first (simctl shows it shut down) and is deleted from there when hopeless
a waiter whose build runs is never reserved (it is skipped in the queue), and a later call does not attach a build to a live lease
